title_vi: Các tầng bộ nhớ đệm, từ trình duyệt tới cơ sở dữ liệu

related.reason_vi: Thử nghiệm proxy ngược làm bộ nhớ đệm dùng chung.
Năm chiến lược giữ bộ nhớ đệm khớp với cơ sở dữ liệu.
Một bài khác của nguồn tổng quan về bộ nhớ đệm.

claims.claim_vi: HTTP caches are shared (reused by more than one user, usually in an intermediary) or private (dedicated to one user, often in a user agent).
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of httpwg/httpwg.github.io at commit 03f35d852e7b64668ab08fda1a8076d6d44d17ae, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Kafka relies on the OS pagecache rather than an in-process cache; consumers pull data and a slow consumer falls behind and catches up; retention discards old data after a fixed time or size.
claims.section: Don't fear the filesystem!; Push vs. pull; Log Compaction
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: shared_buffers sets the memory for shared memory buffers; the default is typically 128MB.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of postgres/postgres at commit 45fc51fcbf4534ea2f6f85e36f8155dbd5ba9851, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: A materialized view persists query results in table-like form; reading it is often much faster but the data is not always current; it is refreshed with REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of postgres/postgres at commit 45fc51fcbf4534ea2f6f85e36f8155dbd5ba9851, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: On PostgreSQL 16.15 with a 200,000-row table: after a restart the first EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) showed shared read=1082 and the second shared hit=1082; a materialized view kept returning 2000 orders and 14000 for customer c7 after a new order until REFRESH, then 2001 and 15000; reading the view took about 0.2 ms versus about 16 ms from the base table.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one virtual machine: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Ubuntu package), throwaway cluster, psql with timing on. SHOW shared_buffers returned 128MB.

claims.claim_vi: Caching layers: client apps, CDNs, load balancers, message brokers such as Kafka, services, distributed caches such as Redis, full-text search engines such as Elasticsearch, databases with buffer pools and materialized views.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Gom tám tầng theo ba vị trí (phía người dùng, phía máy chủ, trong cơ sở dữ liệu); câu hỏi chung đặt ở cuối hình. Thẻ proxy ngược thay cho bộ cân bằng tải vì đó là thứ đã thử.
source_deviations: Source calls Kafka's disk retention a form of cache; the lesson describes, from Kafka's design document, that Kafka relies on the OS pagecache and keeps logs so slow consumers can catch up.
Source's load-balancer layer is shown as a reverse proxy, the component tested in sd-06-002.
The lesson adds a PostgreSQL experiment for the buffer pool and materialized view staleness.
